combo1.title: The K9 Full Combo — Triple Gustav Max
combo1.description: An ambitious combo starting with K9-04 Noroi's Normal Summon, which searches and special summons K9-66a Jokul for an immediate Xyz Summon into K9-17 "Ripper". The line chains through K9-66b Lantern, Infinitrack River Stormer, Heavy Freight Train Derricrane, Revolving Switchyard, Flying Pegasus Railroad Stampede, and the Infinitrack engine to build toward a three-copy Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max endboard supported by Clockwork Knight. Heads-up: this line uses K9-04 Noroi, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

combo2.title: Les 12 Coups de Mehdi — Morphtronic Clocken Burn FTK
combo2.description: An explosive 137-step Machine combo piloted by Mirvu starting from Exceptional Schedule and Urgent Schedule. Brings out Morphtronic Telefon and Night Train Blue Traveler to construct Ancient Gear Ballista, Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker, and Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher into Gadget Gamer. Loops Telefon relentlessly through Power Tool Dragon (searching Overdone Burial), Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon, and Worldsea Dragon Zealantis to repeatedly recycle and tribute Morphtronic Clocken for lethal burn damage in a single turn.
